parameters.prompt: The exact upright white tiger warrior in the reference casts ONE spell in place. From the resting pose it brings both clawed hands together in front of the chest as if forming a seal, bows the head slightly in concentration, then sweeps both arms wide apart to the sides with open palms and holds this open pose for a moment, then lowers the arms and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Both feet stay planted. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, white tiger head, white and black striped fur, silver hair, armor, belt and kilt. No jump, walking, turning, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, magic effects, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: form the seal over the first second and a half, sweep the arms open around two seconds and hold to three seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
